notes.title: Hey guys!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33030867/4347ab27811acf825563037e14c8b60694a44165.jpg[/img]Developer here.

This game is my first expirience with game development.
Do not wait a lot of depth from it, either any new mechanics nor great story/graphics etc.

I'm single game developer who is responsible for anything this game provide and i'm here to improve.

So feel free to tell me what is wrong with this game, what is here to improve or anything to change. I'm open for any constructive criticism.

Thanks for your time! :)

R.P.
